title: mmt-bench ground truth
description: The attacks a pcap contains, which truth.py scores every tool's normalised alerts against (docs/methodology.md, Ground truth).

pcap_sha256.description: The sha256 of the pcap this ground truth describes.

source.description: Where the labels come from (a check/expect file, a dataset's label file, a generator and its seed).

tolerance_s.description: Seconds an alert may fall before an attack's start or after its end and still match it. Default 1.

endpoint.description: An IP address, or a network's canonical address in CIDR form (a scan of a /24).

start.description: Packet time of the attack's first packet, in seconds since the epoch.

end.description: Packet time of the attack's last packet; not before start.

proto.description: When given, an alert matches only with this protocol.

category.description: The attack's class (scan, dos, sqli...). Reported, never matched.

rule_ids.description: Per tool name, the rule ids that detect this attack. When the scored tool has an entry, only an alert with one of these rule ids matches.
